name: cx-goal-one-rule
task: Open the door and then pick up the box in the other room, and try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard clauses for Existence(door_open) and Existence(target_picked_up) correctly capture the mandatory goals (opening the door to enter the second room and picking up the box). The soft clause Precedence(door_open, key_lost) correctly captures the preference 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' by ensuring the key is lost only after the door is opened. The environment constraints (key_lost and door_open never hold together, inability to pick up a second key) make this soft constraint effectively mandatory for success, but its priority remains soft as per the task wording 'try not to'. The compiled machine correctly implements these clauses.
